Extremely disappointing and unprofessional booking experience. I booked a confirmed 4pm appointment for my dog, only for the salon to cancel it at very short notice. They explained that another dog was reactive and required both groomers, and admitted that my appointment slot should have been blocked but wasn’t due to a staff error.

Instead of simply taking responsibility for their scheduling mistake, they pointed out that my appointment had only been booked a few hours earlier—as though that changed the fact that they had accepted and confirmed it. Managing staffing and allowing enough time for dogs requiring additional support is the business’s responsibility, not the customer’s.

This also wasn’t the first time they had cancelled my dog’s appointment for a completely unrelated reason. The repeated cancellations, poor organisation and way this situation was handled caused unnecessary inconvenience. Based on my experience, I would not book with them again 👎🏼👎🏼👎🏼

Previously bought fish from this store to live alongside my male betta as paws for thought closed. Was told at the time it would be fine to live together. Within a week half of my tank had white spot and some of the fish died. Bearing in mind the tank has been running fine for the past 2 years with no white spot issues. I went back to the same store to get another betta as I had thought it could’ve been a bad batch or the type of fish they had in at the time, to be told they can’t sell me a betta as it can’t live alongside guppies, even though they sold me them originally to live with mine. The manager kept repeating its company policy when she didn’t know what to say, assuming she had very little knowledge on what she was trying to explain. Best part about it they had the betta in the tank with mollies that had larger tails than the guppies. Would avoid this store when it comes down to fish.
